note: The description allows three attempts in total; the loop makes four (`<= 3`). Labelled by what the app acts on, the assessment, and by a claim about the bound: a clause that states the extra attempt or a tighter bound, with no negation in that clause.

pr.title: Retry failed uploads
pr.body: Retries a failed upload, making at most three attempts in total, so a flaky network no longer drops files.

review.title: Retry failed uploads
review.description: Retries a failed upload, making at most three attempts in total, so a flaky network no longer drops files.
notes: Compare before/ and after/ for missing or truncated patches.

expect.why: Four attempts where the PR allows three is a bug to fix before merging: a review that finds it requests changes.
Its summary states the extra attempt (four attempts, `<= 3`, off-by-one, one too many) or a tighter bound (`< 3`), in a clause that does not deny it.
A full review puts its findings in `overall`, never in comments.
